rows.text: The party portal reports that Senator Humberto Costa was asked by José Eduardo Dutra to tell 'the President in exercise of the PT, Deputy Rui Falcão (SP)' that Dutra would attend the Diretório Nacional meeting of 29 April; Rui Falcão is styled acting (em exercício) President on 26 April 2011.

rows.text: The same report calls José Eduardo Dutra 'presidente do PT' during his health recovery and says he would personally tell the Diretório Nacional meeting set for 29 April 2011 his decision about his party functions, subject to medical advice.
